title: Service carries the seeker across
summary: Let better company and honest stillness teach the wandering mind how to settle. Keep this close: Carry this with you: roaming ends when the Guru reveals the deeper union.
lifeApplication: When the mind wants more motion, choose one act of devotion or service that returns you to the path you already know.

source.shortMeaning: Through the True Guru, devotion and service become the crossing into union.
source.lifeApplication: Let devotion become concrete before restlessness turns into one more search for novelty.
